note: Readiness / intake checks as configuration. Each rule is advisory and Unverified until a reviewer records the exact APH clause in docs/SOURCES.md; an Unverified rule never blocks, returns or rejects an application (PRD §0). Dates are never stored here — cut-off dates live in calendars.json so there is one source of truth per year.

cut_off.rule: An application submitted after the Public Notice cut-off is queued for the next Academic Year.
cut_off.reject_note: The plan implements the tag half of FR-02 only — 'never reject' — because PRD §0 forbids an Unverified rule from blocking or rejecting. FR-02's literal wording also says 'reject from processing'; that half is deliberately NOT implemented and would need a human approval gate plus a verified cut-off date before it could ever be switched on.
cut_off.date_source_note: The cut-off date is looked up for the submission's calendar year. If no date is recorded for that year the check answers needs_review — never 'no cut-off applies' — because calendars.json ships with no year loaded (IMPL-0016).

blocked_flags.source: md/1_PRD.md FR-03 (APH cl. 2.21f, 2.16.1a, 2.3.1, 2.6e, 2.27); §7 readiness row ('Regional officer clears flags ... official clears/holds each flag')
blocked_flags.note: The five FR-03 block rules as advisory configuration. Nothing here gates a workflow: an evaluation is advice produced on read and stores nothing; only an officer's recorded clear/hold decision (POST, audited, permission-gated) changes a case. An Unverified rule never blocks, returns or rejects an application (PRD §0; DEC-0003).
blocked_flags.evaluation_note: Three-valued per flag: 'flagged' only when every declared input is recorded AND matches the rule; 'clear' only when a RECORDED input provably fails a condition (so the rule cannot apply — a deduction, not a guess); 'needs_review' whenever any required input is not recorded — never a guessed pass (Master Prompt §2 rule 4). 'clear' means 'the rule does not apply to this case', NOT an official clearance: only an officer decision 'cleared' is (PRD §7). Absent data is always unknown, never false.
blocked_flags.clause_mapping_note: FR-03 lists five rules and five clauses as two parallel lists; each flag cites its clause by list position. The mapping is Unverified except bf-02 <-> 2.16.1a (the PRD's clause-notes table: 'Break in EoA | 6 consecutive years without application | 2.16.1a') and bf-04 <-> cl. 2.6 (the PRD's §6 rule 6 makes cl. 2.6 the increase-in-intake clause), both of which the PRD itself cross-confirms.
blocked_flags.input_note: Input field names are declared placeholders for data sources this repo does not integrate: no closure record, no EoA history, no inquiry status, no programme/student-data record, no prior partial-approval record. 'modelled: false' names what must be integrated before that flag can ever evaluate beyond needs_review. The names are labels for missing inputs, never invented data, and the one modelled input (application.category_ids) is absent — i.e. UNKNOWN, not false — for a case that carries no Table 2.3 items.
blocked_flags.decisions_note: The only officer decisions (PRD §7 'clears/holds each flag'). There is deliberately no 'rejected' decision: an Unverified flag never rejects (PRD §0, plan 2.2).

flags.rule: Closure applicants applying for other categories

inputs.description: Whether the applicant institution is applying after a closure (FR-03's own wording). Needs the applicant's closure record; no such record is modelled in this repo.
Whether the application is for a category other than the one the closure applies to. Needs both the closure record and the requested-category mapping; neither is modelled.

flags.source: md/1_PRD.md FR-03 (APH cl. 2.16.1a; PRD clause notes: '6 consecutive years without application -> apply as new institution')

inputs.description: Consecutive years with no extension of approval, per cl. 2.16.1a. Needs the institution's EoA history; none is stored. The 6-year figure is Unverified until a reviewer records the clause.

flags.rule: Standalone PGDM/PGCM without full student data

inputs.description: Whether the case is for a standalone PGDM/PGCM programme. Needs a programme record; applications here carry routing categories, not programme type.
Whether the full student data required with it was submitted. Needs structured student data; documents here are unstructured and no student-data source is modelled.

flags.source: md/1_PRD.md FR-03 (APH cl. 2.6e; the PRD's §6 rule 6 makes cl. 2.6 the increase-in-intake clause)

inputs.description: The case's Table 2.3 category ids; 'contains t23-09' (Increase in Intake / Additional Course(s), per workflow_routes.json) identifies an intake-increase application. Recorded only when the case carries items — an absent item set is UNKNOWN, never 'not an intake increase'.
Whether the institution is under a Central or State inquiry. No inquiry-status source is modelled in this repo, so this input is recorded for no case.

Whether the partial-approval-of-programmes condition of cl. 2.27 applies. The clause text is Unverified and no prior-approval record is modelled, so the condition cannot yet be evaluated for any case.

lease.rule: Remaining lease years > longest course duration, or 30-yr extension on file
lease.source: md/1_PRD.md FR-05, FR-45 and the cl. 2.1e lease note ('EoA stops once the live lease equals the longest course duration unless extended by 30 years'); compliance_rules.json RULE-LEASE-01 (deficiency candidate)
lease.note: Advisory computation only (DEC-0003, PRD §0): it stores nothing, gates nothing and issues no verdict on the case. PRD FR-45 also asks that the lease end date be stored for expiry alerts — the date already lives in the document's extracted fields (validated by validation_service and reported by monitoring_service); this check reuses it rather than copying it.
lease.duration_note: NOT RECORDED — no longest-course-duration figure exists anywhere in this repo, and PRD §19 open question 11 still asks AICTE for the verified lease/expiry requirements for the applicable year. Until a human records an institution's longest course duration here, the comparison answers needs_review — never a guessed 'sufficient' or 'insufficient' (Master Prompt §2 rule 4). The remaining-years computation still runs, so an officer sees the real number.
lease.extension_years_note: PRD-carried from the cl. 2.1e note ('unless extended by 30 years'). Unverified until the clause text is recorded by a rule owner; the figure is config, not code.

extension_on_file.description: Whether a 30-year extension is on file for this lease. No extension register or document type is modelled in this repo, so this input is recorded for no case; an equal-to-duration lease therefore answers needs_review (unknown whether extended), never a silent pass. Absent data is unknown, never false.

lease.evidence_note: Reads the PERSISTED output of the grounded lease extractor through evidence_service.build_snapshot (documents.lease_deed.valid_to, falling back to documents.lease_agreement.valid_to — the only doc type the extractor dispatches for). PDFs are never re-parsed at read time and no model is called: the check is deterministic over stored evidence. An expiry that a human has not verified is still computed but never yields 'sufficient'; the verified flag is returned so the officer sees it.
lease.anniversary_note: Anniversaries are computed on the calendar; a 29 February anniversary in a non-leap year is taken as 28 February (documented assumption, tested).
